authority: User requires effective HiFi >=50x and quality substantially above published minimum standards. Other numerical targets are project-defined, not universal journal rules.
applies_to: Eukaryotic nuclear reference assembly; product, ploidy, biological exceptions and evidence scope must be declared before evaluation.

metrics.uncertainty: Use D/Gmax for a conservative pass; if G or effective D is unavailable return pending. Diploid 50x total is approximately 25x per haplotype, not 50x each.

metrics.applicability: Chromosome-size-dependent; document a biological exception for small chromosomes. Also report NG50 and independently supported G.
Same biological scope as N50. G and its source must be recorded; two-haplotype combined span is not a single-haplotype denominator.
Record method, k, evaluation individual and independent-data flag; a high non-independent estimate is not independent confirmation.
Declare reliable k-mer set and representable denominator. Evaluate each hap plus complete diploid union separately; do not demand all diploid heterozygous k-mers in a single hap.
Report S/D/F/M, lineage, version, mode and ploidy; genuine divergence/duplication requires documented interpretation, not automatic purging.
Only where biological single-copy expectations apply; never substitute for complete BUSCO or false-duplication estimation.
Chromosome-level product only; denominator is all retained target nuclear sequence, including unplaced sequence; report unlocalised fraction separately.
Record estimation unit/denominator and supporting k-mer/depth/self-alignment evidence; not equivalent to BUSCO D.
Also report absolute gap count, N bases/fraction, and definition of gap; project engineering target, not a universal biological guarantee.
Requires appropriate, documented same-species transcript evidence; missing input is pending, not pass.

aggregation: No weighted total or single high_quality boolean. Report data sufficiency, external baseline, project targets, structure review, phasing scope and reproducibility separately. Missing evidence never passes.
t2t_claim: Separate advanced product: per-chromosome gap absence, applicable telomeres, repeat/copy-number and structural support plus appropriate QV; Q60 or terminal telomeres alone are insufficient.
